# Nabeeh - Smart Teaching Assistant

> Bilingual (AR/EN) teaching assistant with WhatsApp bot for student management, attendance tracking, grade management, and automated parent communication.

## About

Nabeeh is a SaaS tool for private tutors and tutoring centers in Egypt/MENA. It replaces spreadsheets with a modern web app that handles students, attendance, grades, and parent communication via WhatsApp.
